says: host.yaml's `restore electron` step still restores main's Electron cache (`electron-<os>-<arch>-<lockfile hash>`), but since pull request 1263 removed today's e2e job, no job saves that cache, so every host.yaml run misses it and downloads Electron again.
proof: At main 0b9067c64, .github/workflows/host.yaml:57-61 restores `~/Library/Caches/electron` under key `electron-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}`. Pull request 1263 (merged 2026-11-14) deleted check.yaml's e2e job, the one job that saved a cache under that key, and the agent merging main into pull request 1266 found no other workflow that saves it.
cost: Each host.yaml run spends the Electron download time on a macOS runner, the costliest runner kind, for a cache it can never hit.
